title: Vibrant Kenyan Jalapeno Skewers
description: A sour and crumbly post-workout Kenyan dish featuring jalapeno, agemono-deep-fry, and ovo-vegetarian-friendly ingredients, cooked in a tandoor clay pot.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the gram flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lemon juice and water to the bowl and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Add the sliced jalapeno peppers to the bowl and toss to coat with the batter.
Dip each jalapeno piece into the beaten eggs and then roll in the gram flour mixture to coat.
Heat the vegetable oil in the tandoor clay pot and deep fry the jalapeno pieces until golden brown.
Remove the jalapeno skewers from the oil and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the Vibrant Kenyan Jalapeno Skewers hot and enjoy.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
